{{Quote|It was my one failure, out on the Fringes.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]|<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
The '''Kaleesh–Imperial conflict''' was a conflict fought between the [[Kaleesh Resistance]] under [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that lasted over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]].

==The conflict==
Following the [[Huk War]], the [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]] desecrated the burial grounds of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oben]], prompting Kaleesh [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]] to return from working for the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] to again lead the [[kolkpravis]]. The IBC sabotaged Sheelal's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the ''[[Martyr]]'', nearly killing him and killing seven of the eight [[Izvoshra/Legends|Izvoshra]], elite warriors who protected him and carried out his will. Qymaen was later resurrected as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]; who played a pivotal role in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GAW" />

The sole surviving Izvoshra, a tyrant of Kalee's western hemisphere named [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]], rallied the kolkpravis and led the [[slaughter of the Yam'rii]] on Oben, where he subsequently moved his people. For over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]], the [[Kaleesh Resistance]] under Bentilais held out until they were finally routed by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] on Oben.<ref name="GAW" />

Thrawn, who was usually able to study his adversaries' art and devise a strategy to defeat them from there, was unable to comprehend Kaleesh artworks, and so [[Bombardment of Oben|leveled]] Oben with his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]; inflicting heavy casualties and bringing an end to the insurrection. Sk'ar survived the deadly bombardment by the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. However, he bore no ill will against his enemy, as he admired their superior technology and tactics and felt his people had died with honor.<ref name="GAW" />

==Aftermath==
When approached by Imperial occupation forces under Captain [[Rel Bentin]], Sk'ar offered his life or his services. Bentin, intimidated by the towering figure of Sk'ar, brought the Kaleesh before Emperor Palpatine. Despite the Empire's [[Speciesism|xenophobia]] towards non-humans, the Emperor was impressed enough by the Kaleesh's courage and potential to accept Sk'ar into the ranks of his Imperial armies.<ref name="GAW" />

Thus, Sk'ar went down in galactic history as one of the few non-humans to reach an important position within the humanocentric Galactic Empire besides [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn and the [[Procurator of Justice]] [[Hethrir]]. With an Imperial strike force under his command, Sk'ar embarked on a [[Subjugation of the Jahilid Drift|campaign]] across the [[Jahilid Drift]], conquering several worlds and making a name for himself in the Imperial Military. Meanwhile, the kolkpravis were taken over by a [[Unidentified female Kaleesh leader|female Kaleesh]] believed to be the second coming of Grievous's dead soulmate, [[Ronderu lij Kummar]].<ref name="GAW" />
